description: R3.1 runtime prefix with the concise prompt syntax already proven by the historical Teacher generator

prompt.template:
Answer the question using the search tool. Search at least once. Keep reasoning concise inside <think>...</think>. To search, emit exactly <search>query</search>; after each search you will receive <information>...</information>. If the visible evidence is insufficient to support every required hop, search again. Finish with exactly <answer>final answer</answer>. Output no text outside the reasoning and the single search or answer action.
Question: {question}

versioning.change: Replace meta-level runtime wording with the concise action prompt already used successfully by the historical Teacher generator.
